article.headline: Brown scores 22 in Kansas City's 73-66 win against East Tennessee State
article.description: — Jamar Brown had 22 points in Kansas City's 73-66 win over East Tennessee State on Saturday.
article.linkText: Brown scores 22 in Kansas City's 73-66 win against East Tennessee State

categories.description: East Tennessee State Buccaneers @ Kansas City Roos

event.description: East Tennessee State Buccaneers @ Kansas City Roos

keywords: East Tennessee State Buccaneers @ Kansas City Roos
article.story: KANSAS CITY, Mo. -- — Jamar Brown had 22 points in Kansas City's 73-66 win over East Tennessee State on Saturday. Brown also contributed eight rebounds for the Roos (8-7). Jayson Petty scored 17 points and added six rebounds. Cameron Faas finished 4 of 6 from 3-point range to finish with 14 points. Quimari Peterson finished with 30 points, six rebounds and two steals for the Buccaneers (7-6). Jaden Seymour added 15 points and two steals for East Tennessee State. Roosevelt Wheeler also had nine points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
